title: feat(pr-review): opt in to reviewing outside contributors' pull requests

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Held at 8 because a warning is open. 1 warning −1 · tests covered · risk medium Adds an off-by-default `reviewExternalContributors` setting so an outside author's public pull request gets one automatic review, wired through org/repo config, the settings form and the trigger gate. Sound apart from the one-review cap not counting reviews still running. - `reviewExternalContributors` joins `PrReviewRepositoryConfig` and `mergePrReviewConfig` - `onPullRequestEvent` reviews an outside author once the setting is on - Outside authors are capped at one push-started review, then get a paused check - The rules form renders it as a switch for the org, an inherit select for a repository ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · Outside-author one-review bound ignores reviews still in flight correctness · [`packages/backend/src/services/pr-review/PrReviewService.ts:2084-2085`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/6cfed3b09fc28051b80d9c586f0fb8d38086dd9e/packages/backend/src/services/pr-review/PrReviewService.ts#L2084-L2085) The bound of 1 is checked against `earlier`, which counts only rows with status `completed` or `failed` (`PrReviewService.ts:2111`). A push that lands while the first review is `queued` or `running` therefore sees 0, supersedes that review and queues its own, which the 90s debounced copy then starts — so an outside contributor pushing every few minutes keeps starting reviews, the spend this setting says it caps. Count every row of the pull request for outside authors, whatever its status. ``` In the `earlier` query, drop the status filter when the author is outside: `...(outsideAuthor ? [] : [$.status.in_("completed", "failed")])` after `$.headSha.neq(headSha)`, so a second head is paused as soon as the first review row exists. ```
### Production impact
Telemetry this change adds and removes (1) - ➕ attribute `maple.pr_review.external_author` · `packages/backend/src/services/pr-review/PrReviewService.ts:2046`
What was checked - The gate still needs a public repo and an automatic trigger only (`PrReviewService.ts:2031`) - The 90s debounced copy re-checks the author gate before starting its queued row (`PrReviewService.ts:2052`) - Org defaults merge the field and a repository's `false` overrides them (`pr-review.ts:312`, `state.ts:169`)
`6cfed3b` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Opt-in and off by default; both new gates (per-PR cap, per-author quota) and the settings save path are pinned by tests at this head.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium · 1/1 new units observable</sub>

Adds the opt-in `reviewExternalContributors` setting, bounding an outside author to one automatic review per pull request and three a day, with the settings toggle and tests. The previous review's finding is fixed; safe to merge.

- `outsideAuthor` no longer skips outright, it caps automatic reviews at one (`PrReviewService.ts:2109`)
- Superseded and running reviews now count against the outsider cap
- New per-author daily quota of three reviews across the org
- `reviewExternalContributors` added to domain config, form state and settings toggle

### Fixed since the last review

- ✅ ~~F1 · Outside-author one-review bound ignores reviews still in flight~~

### Production impact

<details><summary>Telemetry this change adds and removes (1)</summary>

</details>

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- F1 fixed: outsiders' `earlier` count drops the `completed`/`failed` filter (`PrReviewService.ts:2137`), so a mid-run push sees the in-flight review
- Quota is scoped to the org and excludes the current head, so a webhook redelivery is still caught by the `existingHead` path
- Requested reviews (`@maple review`, CI approval) bypass both gates via `mode === "automatic"` at `PrReviewService.ts:2035`

</details>

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Default-off opt-in gate with the one-review cap, the three-a-day quota and the repo override each pinned by backend tests; the only file changed since the last pass is the settings view.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium · 1/1 new units observable</sub>

Adds an opt-in `reviewExternalContributors` setting so outside contributors' pull requests get one automatic review, capped at three per author a day, with the settings toggle in /code-review/settings. Off by default and bounded; safe to merge.

- `reviewExternalContributors` joins `PrReviewRepositoryConfig`, off by default, org default with per-repository override
- `onPullRequestEvent` reviews an outside author once per pull request instead of skipping it
- A new org-wide quota skips an outside author's fourth review of the day
- The settings form renders the toggle as a switch or an inherit select

### Production impact

<details><summary>Telemetry this change adds and removes (1)</summary>

- ➕ attribute `maple.pr_review.external_author` · `packages/backend/src/services/pr-review/PrReviewService.ts:2049`

</details>

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- New quota count filters `orgId`, `authorLogin`, the UTC day and excludes the current head (`PrReviewService.ts:2092`)
- Every new skip branch annotates the existing `onPullRequestEvent` span; no new entrypoint or outbound call
- `reviewExternalContributors` is `optionalKey`, so stored configs and the jsonb column still decode

</details>

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
The new quota predicate, the outsider status filter and the one-review cap are each pinned by a test that fails on the old code; no defect found in the two changed files.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium</sub>

Opt-in `reviewExternalContributors` lets an outside contributor's pull request get one automatic review, capped at three reviews per author per day across the organization. The head's quota predicate and outsider limit behave as described; safe to merge.

- `reviewExternalContributors` defaults off; when on, an outside author's PR starts a review
- Later pushes post a skipped `automatic_limit` check instead of a second review
- Per-author daily cap of three automatic reviews, counted org-wide
- Superseded and running reviews now count toward an outsider's single review
